rot.drive.ideia.ex1.e1: Attack: the black king must be driven to a8, the corner of your bishop's colour. The bishop already controls the light diagonal from a2 to g8, but the black king can still cross it on the dark squares, such as d4.
rot.drive.ideia.ex1.certo: Attack: the knight goes to f5, and only this move works: on f5 it controls d4, d6, e7 and g7, the dark squares where the black king would cross the diagonal.
rot.drive.ideia.ex1.revela: Attack: the best move takes the knight to f5. On f5 it controls d4, d6, e7 and g7, the dark squares the bishop cannot reach.
rot.drive.ideia.ex1.err.h6f7.1: Attack: the knight goes to f7, a square from which it does not control d4.
rot.drive.ideia.ex1.err.h6f7.2: Defence: Black finds a resource: the king crosses the diagonal on d4 and heads for the centre.
rot.drive.ideia.ex1.err.h6g8.1: Attack: the knight goes to g8, a square from which it does not control d4.
rot.drive.ideia.ex1.err.h6g8.2: Defence: Black finds a resource: the king crosses the diagonal on d4 and heads for the centre.
rot.drive.ideia.ex1.err.h6g4.1: Attack: the knight goes to g4, a square from which it does not control d4.
rot.drive.ideia.ex1.err.h6g4.2: Defence: Black finds a resource: the king crosses the diagonal on d4 and heads for the centre.
rot.drive.ideia.ex1.err.a3a2.1: Attack: the king goes to a2, but the dark squares by the diagonal are still uncontrolled.
rot.drive.ideia.ex1.err.a3a2.2: Defence: Black finds a resource: the king crosses the diagonal on d4 and heads for the centre.
rot.drive.ideia.ex1.err.a3a4.1: Attack: the king goes to a4, but the dark squares by the diagonal are still uncontrolled.
rot.drive.ideia.ex1.err.a3a4.2: Defence: Black finds a resource: the king crosses the diagonal on d4 and heads for the centre.
rot.drive.ideia.ex1.err.a3b2.1: Attack: the king goes to b2, but the dark squares by the diagonal are still uncontrolled.
rot.drive.ideia.ex1.err.a3b2.2: Defence: Black finds a resource: the king goes to d6, from where it crosses the diagonal on e5.
rot.drive.ideia.ex1.err.b3d1.1: Attack: the bishop goes to d1 and leaves the a2–g8 diagonal.
rot.drive.ideia.ex1.err.b3d1.2: Defence: Black finds a resource: the king walks through d5, a light square the bishop has left free.
rot.drive.ideia.ex1.err.b3c2.1: Attack: the bishop goes to c2 and leaves the a2–g8 diagonal.
rot.drive.ideia.ex1.err.b3c2.2: Defence: Black finds a resource: the king walks through d5, a light square the bishop has left free.
rot.drive.ideia.ex1.err.b3a4.1: Attack: the bishop goes to a4 and leaves the a2–g8 diagonal.
rot.drive.ideia.ex1.err.b3a4.2: Defence: Black finds a resource: the king walks through d5, a light square the bishop has left free.
rot.drive.ideia.ex1.err.b3a2.1: Attack: the bishop goes to a2 and stays on the diagonal, but the dark squares are still uncontrolled.
rot.drive.ideia.ex1.err.b3a2.2: Defence: Black finds a resource: the king crosses the diagonal on d4 and heads for the centre.
rot.drive.ideia.ex1.err.b3g8.1: Attack: the bishop goes to g8 and stays on the diagonal, but the dark squares are still uncontrolled.
rot.drive.ideia.ex1.err.b3g8.2: Defence: Black finds a resource: the king crosses the diagonal on d4 and heads for the centre.
rot.drive.ideia.ex1.err.b3e6.1: Attack: the bishop goes to e6 and stays on the diagonal, but the dark squares are still uncontrolled.
rot.drive.ideia.ex1.err.b3e6.2: Defence: Black finds a resource: the king goes to d6, from where it crosses the diagonal on e5.
rot.drive.ideia.ex1.err.b3f7.1: Attack: the bishop goes to f7 and stays on the diagonal, but the dark squares are still uncontrolled.
rot.drive.ideia.ex1.err.b3f7.2: Defence: Black finds a resource: the king goes to d6, from where it crosses the diagonal on e5.
rot.drive.ideia.ex1.err.b3c4.1: Attack: the bishop goes to c4, next to the black king, and is left unprotected.
rot.drive.ideia.ex1.err.b3c4.2: Defence: Black finds a resource: the king captures the bishop, and without it there is no mate: a draw.
rot.drive.ideia.ex1.err.b3d5.1: Attack: the bishop goes to d5, next to the black king, and is left unprotected.
rot.drive.ideia.ex1.err.b3d5.2: Defence: Black finds a resource: the king captures the bishop, and without it there is no mate: a draw.
rot.drive.ideia.ex1.l1: Attack: bishop, knight and king now form a barrier, a line of squares the black king cannot cross. Behind it, he is left with only these squares, next to the a8 corner.
rot.drive.ideia.ex1.l2: Attack: each piece covers one part: the bishop the light squares of the diagonal, the knight the dark squares beside it, and your king a4 and b4.
rot.drive.ideia.ex1.p: Attack: think and suggest a move, or tap {verResposta}
rot.drive.ideia.ex1.fora: That move is not among the ones we study here. Back to the position.
rot.drive.ideia.ex1.volta: Back to the position. Suggest another move or tap {verResposta}
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.e1: Defence: the black king goes to b5 and stands next to your king: now your king cannot step up to a4 or b4.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.e2: Attack: the barrier is closed and the black king cannot cross it. The problem is that it is White to move: how can you pass the move without opening any square?
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.certo: Attack: the bishop drops back to f7 and stays on the same diagonal. The barrier is unchanged, and the move passes to Black.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.revela: Attack: the bishop can drop back to f7 without leaving the diagonal. The barrier is unchanged, and the move passes to Black.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.alt.b3a2.1: Attack: this works too: from a2 the bishop stays on the diagonal, and the barrier stays closed.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.alt.b3a2.2: Attack: now to the main line, with the bishop on f7.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.alt.b3e6.1: Attack: this works too: from e6 the bishop stays on the diagonal, and the barrier stays closed.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.alt.b3e6.2: Attack: now to the main line, with the bishop on f7.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.alt.b3g8.1: Attack: this works too: from g8 the bishop stays on the diagonal, and the barrier stays closed.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.alt.b3g8.2: Attack: now to the main line, with the bishop on f7.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.alt.b3d5.1: Attack: the barrier stays closed, but the black king can go to c5 and attack the bishop, which will have to move again.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.alt.b3d5.2: Attack: now to the main line, with the bishop on f7, far from the black king.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.err.f5e3.1: Attack: the knight goes to e3 and no longer controls d4.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.err.f5e3.2: Defence: Black finds a resource: the king returns to c5, ready to cross the diagonal on d4.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.err.f5g3.1: Attack: the knight goes to g3 and no longer controls d4.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.err.f5g3.2: Defence: Black finds a resource: the king returns to c5, ready to cross the diagonal on d4.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.err.f5h4.1: Attack: the knight goes to h4 and no longer controls d4.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.err.f5h4.2: Defence: Black finds a resource: the king returns to c5, ready to cross the diagonal on d4.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.err.f5h6.1: Attack: the knight goes to h6 and no longer controls d4.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.err.f5h6.2: Defence: Black finds a resource: the king returns to c5, ready to cross the diagonal on d4.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.err.f5e7.1: Attack: the knight goes to e7 and no longer controls d4.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.err.f5e7.2: Defence: Black finds a resource: the king returns to c5, ready to cross the diagonal on d4.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.err.f5g7.1: Attack: the knight goes to g7 and no longer controls d4.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.err.f5g7.2: Defence: Black finds a resource: the king returns to c5, ready to cross the diagonal on d4.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.err.f5d4.1: Attack: the knight gives check on d4, but is left unprotected.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.err.f5d4.2: Defence: Black finds a resource: the king goes to c5 and attacks the knight; once it moves, d4 is free.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.err.f5d6.1: Attack: the knight gives check on d6, but is left unprotected.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.err.f5d6.2: Defence: Black finds a resource: the king goes to c5 and attacks the knight, with d4 already free for the crossing.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.err.a3a2.1: Attack: the king goes to a2 and no longer controls b4.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.err.a3a2.2: Defence: Black finds a resource: the king steps into b4, on the other side of the barrier.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.err.a3b2.1: Attack: the king goes to b2 and no longer controls b4.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.err.a3b2.2: Defence: Black finds a resource: the king steps into b4 and gains room; your king will have to win it back.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.err.b3a4.1: Attack: the bishop goes to a4 and leaves the a2–g8 diagonal.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.err.b3a4.2: Defence: Black finds a resource: the king steps into c4, a light square the bishop has left free.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.err.b3d1.1: Attack: the bishop goes to d1 and leaves the a2–g8 diagonal.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.err.b3d1.2: Defence: Black finds a resource: the king steps into c4, a light square the bishop has left free.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.err.b3c2.1: Attack: the bishop goes to c2 and leaves the a2–g8 diagonal.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.err.b3c2.2: Defence: Black finds a resource: the king steps into c4, a light square the bishop has left free.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.err.b3c4.1: Attack: the bishop gives check on c4, next to the black king, and is left unprotected.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.err.b3c4.2: Defence: Black finds a resource: the king captures the bishop, and without it there is no mate: a draw.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.l1: Attack: a move like this is called a waiting move: it changes nothing important and only passes the move. Now Black must move the king, and any square it gives up your king can take.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.l2: Defence: the black king returns to c5 and looks to cross the diagonal on d4, but the knight controls that square.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.l3: Attack: since the black king has given up a4, your king steps up there and takes b5 away from him.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.l4: Defence: the black king goes to b6 and stands next to your king again, so that it cannot step up to a5 or b5.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.l5: Attack: your king goes round via b4 and takes c5 away from the black king. The barrier is still closed, and his region has shrunk, still next to the a8 corner.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.l6: Attack: this is the method: the barrier holds the black king; when your king cannot advance, a waiting move passes the move without opening the barrier.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.p: Attack: think and suggest a move, or tap {verResposta}
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.fora: That move is not among the ones we study here. Back to the position.
rot.drive.ideia.ex2.volta: Back to the position. Suggest another move or tap {verResposta}
rot.drive.demos.selar.1: Attack demonstration: the bishop is on the a2–g8 diagonal, and your king covers e7 and e8. The dark squares beside the diagonal, such as b4, c5 and e5, are still open.
rot.drive.demos.selar.2: Attack: the knight goes to d3 and controls b4, c5 and e5. The barrier is closed: the black king is held next to the a8 corner, and only via a3 could it reach the bishop.
rot.drive.demos.selar.3: Defence: the black king goes to d6, towards the centre, away from the corner.
rot.drive.demos.selar.4: Attack: your king comes to e8 and takes d7 and d8 away from the black king.
rot.drive.demos.selar.5: Defence: the black king has to move and goes to c6, still far from a8.
rot.drive.demos.selar.6: Attack: the bishop moves up to b3 without leaving the diagonal and takes a4 away from the black king; with it, a3 is out of his reach too.
rot.drive.demos.selar.7: Defence: the black king returns to d6, heading for the centre again.
rot.drive.demos.selar.8: Attack: your king goes to d8 and takes c7 and c8 away from the black king.
rot.drive.demos.selar.9: Defence: the black king goes to c6, against the barrier again.
rot.drive.demos.selar.10: Attack: your king goes to e7 and takes d6 away from the black king. His region has shrunk, always next to the a8 corner.
rot.drive.demos.ataqueBispo.1: Attack demonstration: the barrier holds the black king next to the h1 corner. The weak point is the bishop on d3, far from your king. Watch how Black exploits it.
rot.drive.demos.ataqueBispo.2: Defence: the black king attacks the bishop. If it leaves the diagonal, the barrier opens.
rot.drive.demos.ataqueBispo.3: Attack: the bishop drops back to c2 without leaving the b1–h7 diagonal, and now your king protects it.
rot.drive.demos.ataqueBispo.4: Defence: with the bishop protected, the black king drops back to e1, away from your king.
rot.drive.demos.ataqueBispo.5: Attack: your king comes to c1, takes d1 and d2 away from the black king and keeps protecting the bishop.
rot.drive.demos.ataqueBispo.6: Defence: the black king looks for room on e2, away from your king and from the corner.
rot.drive.demos.ataqueBispo.7: Attack: a waiting move. The bishop goes to g6, stays on the diagonal and, far from the black king, needs no protection.
rot.drive.demos.ataqueBispo.8: Defence: the black king steps up to e3 and looks to cross on d4 or f4, but the knight controls both squares.
rot.drive.demos.ataqueBispo.9: Attack: your king steps up to d1 and takes e1 and e2 away from the black king.
rot.drive.demos.ataqueBispo.10: Defence: with no squares in the centre, the black king drops back to f2, towards the corner.
rot.drive.demos.ataqueBispo.11: Attack: your king goes up to d2 and takes e3 away from the black king. The barrier is still closed, and his region has shrunk.
rot.drive.pratica.selar.enunciado: Attack: play White and close the barrier that holds the black king next to the h1 corner.
rot.drive.pratica.selar.fim: Attack: on e6 the knight controls d4, f4 and g5, and the barrier is closed. Only via c1 could the black king reach the bishop.

rot.drive.pratica.selar.v1.err.b3c3.2: Black replies 1...Kf4: the black king crosses the diagonal on f4, a dark square still free.
